focus_areas: Eye iris color accuracy (Teal vs Golden)
Skin texture saturation and pattern regularity
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay special attention to the eye color. Is the teal/cyan iris a valid variation for Iguana iguana or a definitive AI artifact? Also, evaluate if the green skin tone is biologically plausible or if it exhibits the 'uniform noise' pattern typical of diffusion models. Ensure the Open Vocabulary Detector's bounding boxes are used to guide the Perceptual Quality Auditor's analysis of the iris and skin texture.
image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a green iguana perched on a branch. The image focuses heavily on the head and upper torso. The iguana has vibrant green skin with some greyish tones on the snout, a prominent dewlap, and a visible dorsal crest. The eye is strikingly bright teal/green. The background is blurred foliage and a fence.
